content.text:
I've submitted index 0 (Fe₀.₈₁Sb₀.₁₉) as the best composition. It was the only one of the three I measured with a positive EQE, and even that is small: about 0.0057%.

| Index | Fe : Sb | Why I measured it | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.81 : 0.19 | Fe-rich end, likely Sb-doped hematite | **0.0057** |
| 12 | 0.51 : 0.49 | FeSbO₄: stable, predicted gap 2.08 eV, right at the 2.1 eV light | −0.0003 |
| 20 | 0.29 : 0.71 | Unexplored Sb-rich end | −0.0003 |

- **The obvious candidate didn't work.** The model predictions made FeSbO₄ the best bet, but it showed no photoresponse.
- **Activity rises with iron content** across these three points, and index 0 is already the most Fe-rich composition in the library.
- **Not covered:** after index 0 came out positive, the Gaussian-process model suggested indices 3–7 (Fe 0.66–0.76). Its predicted mean there is below index 0, but uncertain. I used the last measurement on the Sb-rich end instead, so I can't rule out a slightly better composition in that range.
- **XRD not used:** I didn't spend any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phases are present at each composition is inferred, not confirmed.
